review_method: Read all four existing target-language essays for context. Reread approved changes and surrounding argument chains across all four essays against Chinese; after editing, compared all 31 changed units line by line with finalized Chinese. The historic full comparative reread remains recorded separately. Structural tests supplement rather than replace semantic review.
specific_semantic_checks: Photograph: understood evidence, concealment, approximately ten minutes, destruction through fear rather than reflex.

Private life: future dress distinguished from makeup and lipstick; attempted Brotherhood participation retained; Party suppression of sexual pleasure made explicit without reducing experience to political utility.
Julia: earlier not-dead-yet reply distinguished from pre-arrest dead exchange; present life not equated with absence of any future expectation.
Cross-references identify essay 3; forbidden book arrives later through briefcase exchange.
Torture: dial controls pain, not asserted electrical mechanism; physical destruction of certainty and authorial judgments retained; ending identifies two final sentences.
Appendix: Book-of-the-Month Club deletion request distinguished from unsupported relocation claim; final position remains an interpretive argument, not documented authorial instruction.
Proles: less comprehensive ideological training does not mean no surveillance; literacy is not categorically denied; song meaning remains irreducible to state purpose.
Preserved the authorial claim that the demand for all cannot be completed, the irreversibility of lived events, and the appendix reading as a possibility rather than proof of historical collapse.

limits: This pass synchronizes the approved corrections; historical review comments are provenance, not current blockers.
